program: Stellantis Website Guidelines / Dealer Advertising Program

checks.title: Website Navigation Colors
checks.description: Primary navigation must use black and white only. No colored navigation bars. Brand-specific accent colors are restricted to designated content areas only.

checks.title: Brand Tab Navigation
checks.description: Multi-brand dealers must use brand-specific tabs/sections. Each brand (Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep, Ram) must have its own clearly separated navigation path.

checks.title: Brand Logo Placement
checks.description: Each Stellantis brand logo must appear in its respective section. Chrysler wing, Dodge red stripe, Jeep grille, and Ram head must follow current brand standards.

checks.title: No Mixed Brand Logos
checks.description: Brand logos must not be combined or displayed together in a way that creates confusion. Each brand section must feel like a standalone brand experience.

checks.title: VLP Requirements
checks.description: Vehicle Listing Pages (VLP) must show: vehicle image, year/make/model/trim, MSRP clearly labeled, stock number, and key features. Stellantis requires specific VLP layout standards.

checks.title: VDP Requirements
checks.description: Vehicle Detail Pages (VDP) must include: multiple vehicle photos, full specifications, MSRP labeled as such, VIN, stock number, and standard/optional equipment list.

checks.title: MSRP Labeling on VDP
checks.description: MSRP must be clearly labeled as 'Manufacturer\'s Suggested Retail Price' or 'MSRP'. Internet/dealer price must be visually distinct from MSRP. Must include destination charge.

checks.title: Brand-Specific Color Palette
checks.description: Each brand has its own color palette: Chrysler (silver/blue), Dodge (red/black), Jeep (green/khaki), Ram (black/silver). Brand sections must use their respective palettes.

checks.title: Maximum One Pop-Up
checks.description: Stellantis allows a maximum of one pop-up or overlay on the dealer website. Multiple pop-ups, especially on initial page load, violate guidelines.

checks.title: DAP Content Requirements
checks.description: Dealer Advertising Program (DAP) content must follow Stellantis digital advertising standards. All offers must include required disclaimers and proper brand attribution.

checks.title: Stellantis Digital Call Tracking
checks.description: Dealers using Stellantis digital programs must implement approved call tracking solutions. Third-party tracking that conflicts with Stellantis systems is not permitted.

checks.title: Vehicle Photography Standards
checks.description: Vehicle photos must accurately represent the vehicle. Must use Stellantis-approved studio shots or actual dealer inventory photos. ChromeData/Evox images acceptable for stock representation.

checks.title: Stellantis CPO Branding
checks.description: Only vehicles certified through Stellantis official CPO programs may use certified branding. Each brand (Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep, Ram) has its own CPO program standards.

checks.title: Certified Website Provider
checks.description: Dealer website must be hosted by a Stellantis-certified website provider. Non-certified providers may not have access to required data feeds and integrations.

checks.title: Model Name Accuracy
checks.description: Stellantis model names must be used correctly. Current nameplates: Chrysler (Pacifica, 300), Dodge (Hornet, Durango, Charger), Jeep (Wrangler, Grand Cherokee, Compass, etc.), Ram (1500, 2500, 3500, ProMaster).

checks.title: Stellantis Required Disclaimers
checks.description: All advertising must include Stellantis-required disclaimers including trademark attribution, safety disclaimers for capability claims (Jeep off-road, Ram towing), and offer terms.

checks.title: Jeep Trail Rated / Capability Claims
checks.description: Jeep Trail Rated badge and off-road capability claims require specific disclaimers. Professional driver / closed course disclaimers needed for action imagery.

checks.title: Ram Towing / Payload Claims
checks.description: Ram towing and payload capacity claims must include proper disclaimers noting that actual capabilities depend on configuration. Must reference specific trim/configuration.

checks.title: Stellantis EV Branding
checks.description: Stellantis EV models (Jeep 4xe, Ram REV, Dodge Charger Daytona, Chrysler Airflow) have specific branding requirements. Range and charging claims must include EPA disclaimers.
